title: Inner harmonies stitched into outer bases
claim: Proved by hand: an outer not-all-equal base whose distinctions are inner harmonies, each outer knot a stitch at every place, allows exactly the outer states at each place, lives exactly when the outer base lives, and does so at every level (every outer state lifts, x = s xor w); only the alternation is read as one distinction exactly; ties of levels are products of the seed's; shifts matter only around closed chains and for the alternation are signs. Exact on frozen ranges: five finite seeds to level 4 and a drawn three-copy nesting to level 7 force nothing new; shifted stitches end a living pattern only where all four triples of four distinctions are knotted, and revive the Fano plane almost always. The levels arm was dropped at its cap; a descriptive follow-up confirmed the advisor's counts. Referee pending.
failure_conditions: An outer state that no state of the nested base realises under stitches at one place.
A tie of a level that is not a product of the seed's ties.
A distinction of the three-copy nesting tied to another, to level 7.
remaining_obligations: Independent referee (the background referee thread): pending.
foundation_claim_scope: The plain not-all-equal law; harmonies along one shift (span <= 8, P <= 16) as inner series; finite outer patterns of up to 7 distinctions, levels of five seeds to 4, a drawn three-copy nesting to level 7.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-12, pre-registered (commit 8e2e41275); independent referee pending with the background referee thread.
validation.status: lemmas by hand; exact census on frozen ranges (check.py); levels arm dropped at its cap, descriptive follow-up (after_run_levels.py); referee pending
